methodology: Closed-loop async workloads with deterministic service-time and priority distributions.
purpose: Measure scheduler throughput, queueing latency, utilization, and cross-task fairness under representative contention.
limitations: Synthetic service times stand in for agent execution and do not measure provider latency.
Results are machine-dependent and should be compared on the same host profile.
The benchmark does not include Redis, MongoDB, or network overhead.

profiles.description: Moderate mixed-priority load across six independent tasks.
High fan-in load with only two global slots and longer service times.
